 BIGBANG Bring ‘XX : COSMOS’ World Tour To SoFi Stadium For 20th Anniversary Celebration
 Nov 5, 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Print 
 20 years of music, a long awaited reunion and stadiums filled with fans singing along to some of K-pop’s most influential songs. BIGBANG are celebrating their extraordinary legacy on a global scale, and the party is getting even bigger. The legendary Korean group have added a special Los Angeles performance to their ‘XX : COSMOS’ World Tour, bringing G-DRAGON, TAEYANG and DAESUNG to SoFi Stadium on March 13, 2027.
 And for American fans, this is a particularly exciting announcement.
 The newly added concert represents the final scheduled opportunity for U.S. V.I.Ps, the group’s devoted fan community, to experience BIGBANG’s 20th anniversary reunion tour. The production has already travelled across international stadiums, attracting enormous audiences and celebrating the music that helped transform K-pop into a worldwide cultural phenomenon.
 For a group whose influence reaches far beyond music, the anniversary carries tremendous significance.
 BIGBANG debuted in 2006 and quickly developed a musical identity that combined hip hop, pop, electronic production and distinctive individual personalities. Their adventurous approach to songwriting, performance and fashion helped establish new possibilities for Korean musicians reaching international audiences.
 Over the years, songs including “Fantastic Baby,” “Bang Bang Bang,” “Haru Haru” and “Loser” became favourites among fans around the world, while the group’s imaginative music videos and commanding live performances helped introduce millions of listeners to Korean popular music.
 Their impact has continued across generations.
 Artists who followed BIGBANG have drawn inspiration from the group’s willingness to experiment with different musical styles, develop distinctive visual identities and pursue creative projects beyond traditional group activities. G-DRAGON, TAEYANG and DAESUNG have also established individual careers that reflect their different musical interests and personalities.
 Now they’re sharing a stage again for the first time since 2017, giving longtime fans an opportunity to celebrate the songs and performances that have accompanied nearly two decades of musical memories.
 And the reunion comes with new music.
 BIGBANG released “BiiiG” on August 19, 2026, marking their 20th anniversary with their first new song in four years. The celebratory recording brings together the group’s recognizable rap and vocal styles, playful lyricism and energetic production, introducing another chapter in their musical story.
 The response was immediate.
 “BiiiG” topped major Korean streaming charts including Melon, Genie, Bugs and VIBE, reaching #1 on Melon’s TOP100 within an hour of release. The achievement demonstrated the extraordinary anticipation surrounding the group’s return and the enthusiasm of listeners who have followed their music across multiple eras.
 There’s something remarkable about a group celebrating 20 years together while continuing to attract such an enthusiastic response to new material.
 That momentum has carried directly into the ‘XX : COSMOS’ World Tour, which has already brought BIGBANG to stadium audiences across Asia and beyond. The itinerary includes multiple performances in some of the world’s most celebrated concert venues, with stops in Bangkok, Hong Kong, Osaka, Nagoya, Tokyo, Fukuoka, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, Manila and Kaohsiung.
 The scale of the tour is especially impressive.
 In Hong Kong, the group has scheduled four performances at Kai Tak Stadium, while Japanese fans will have opportunities to see three concerts at Kyocera Dome Osaka and another three at Tokyo Dome. Those extended runs reflect the enormous audiences BIGBANG have developed throughout their career.
 For fans who grew up with the group’s music, these concerts represent an opportunity to reconnect with a soundtrack that helped define an era. Newer listeners can experience firsthand the musical personalities and performance style that have influenced so much of contemporary K-pop.
 And then there’s Los Angeles.
 SoFi Stadium has become one of the most recognizable entertainment destinations in the United States, hosting major concerts and international sporting events. Bringing BIGBANG’s anniversary celebration to the enormous California venue offers another fitting moment in a career defined by ambitious performances and international milestones.
 The concert also highlights the remarkable growth of Korean music’s global audience since BIGBANG first emerged in 2006.
 At that time, international opportunities for K-pop performers were considerably more limited. Today, Korean musicians regularly headline major arenas and stadiums around the world, with enthusiastic audiences spanning generations and continents.
 BIGBANG helped establish the foundation for that expansion through their distinctive sound, international touring success and enduring cultural influence.
 Their dedicated V.I.P community has remained an essential part of the story, supporting the group’s recordings, solo projects and performances throughout the years. The current reunion gives those fans another opportunity to celebrate everything the musicians have accomplished.
 Presale registration for the Los Angeles concert is open through November 8 at 10 p.m. Pacific Time through BIGBANG’s official b.stage platform. The V.I.P membership presale begins November 11 at 10 a.m. Pacific, followed by the general public sale on November 13 at 10 a.m. Pacific.
 With stadium performances continuing into 2027, the anniversary celebration is bringing together audiences across multiple continents.
 20 years after their debut, BIGBANG are demonstrating the lasting appeal of music that helped change the international pop landscape. From a chart topping new single to a worldwide stadium reunion, G-DRAGON, TAEYANG and DAESUNG are giving fans plenty of reasons to celebrate.
 And with SoFi Stadium now on the schedule, the ‘XX : COSMOS’ World Tour has another enormous night waiting on the horizon.
